steps.what: Match transcript lines to the programme script for a rough assembly.

loop.purpose: Bind each cut to a transcript line and a script line.
loop.input: The transcript and the programme script already held.
loop.output: A rough assembly of matched lines only.
loop.check: Each cut cites both line ids and the words match.
loop.stop: No line id, the words do not match, or the cut would invent a shot.
loop.why_not_simpler: A fixed cut list cannot tell which transcript line is missing from the programme script.

steps.what: Edit videotapes by erasing and removing portions and adding video or sound.
File the accepted edit of the required programme portions.

tasks.design: A rough assembly in {DOCS} keeps only transcript lines that match the programme script, and it stops when a line is missing. The audio technician edits the videotape by erasing and removing portions and by adding video or sound. The accepted edit is filed only after that work, for that version. The assembly is not the edit. It does not invent a shot. A script with no transcript is not assembled.
tasks.previous_blocker: The editor searched the tape by picture, and a cut could not be tied back to a line in the script.
tasks.enabler_now: A transcript can be matched to a script for a first assembly. The technician still makes the edit.
tasks.still_hard: Pacing, and whether a removed portion still leaves the programme making sense, stay with the technician.
tasks.human_edge: The technician edits the programme and accepts the version that is filed. The rough assembly is not that edit.
tasks.altitude: The technician still edits. A rough assembly is only a first pass of lines that match, and nothing is filed until the technician accepts that edit.

reach.task: Pick the frame after a first pass has only grouped the sharp ones.
reach.learn: A first pass is not the selection.

evidence.claim: Matching a clip transcript to a script can build a rough cut. That result is not a finished edit.
One published test compared a timeline cut with a transcript cut by a single editor who already knew the cuts on the second pass. That timing is not a saving to copy.

An altered image or video that resembles a real person or event and would falsely appear authentic must be disclosed. A cut that only uses matched source lines is not that case, and a cut that would invent a shot stops.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An audio and video technician in a mid-size European company. A stored equipment id is not a repair, and a draft is not the show.

Fields: The transcript line id and the script line id. A line with no id is not assembled. The assembly may not invent a shot. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the audio technician finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the transcript already produced for the programme before sending the picture to a new tool.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the audio technician.
unknowns: Whether this company already holds transcripts for programme tape, or only for new files.
research_questions: Who may accept an edit for filing, the technician or the director?

already_counted.description: Editing the videotape and accepting the version stay with the technician.

incremental.description: Drop rough assemblies whose programme was withdrawn.

approvals.approved_version: edit version and the transcript line ids it cites

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The technician still edits the videotape and still accepts the version that is filed. The rough assembly removes only the search for lines that already match. A tape with no transcript saves nothing, and the published timing from one editor is not used as the saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the scheduled production or broadcast and its tape id.
Obtain, set up, and load videotapes for scheduled productions or broadcasts.
Set aside a tape that is not the scheduled one.

tasks.design: The {PROJECT} board shows the scheduled production or broadcast and the tape id already assigned. The audio technician obtains, sets up, and loads that videotape. A tape that is not the scheduled one is set aside. The schedule does not load the tape. A broadcast with no tape id leaves the screen blank.
tasks.previous_blocker: The schedule was a printed rundown, and the tape was identified by a handwritten spine.
tasks.enabler_now: The assigned tape id can be shown. Loading the tape stays in the technician's hands.
tasks.still_hard: A tape can carry the right id and still be the wrong cut once it is seen.
tasks.human_edge: The technician loads the tape and sets aside one that is not the scheduled item.
tasks.altitude: Loading stays physical. The schedule shows the tape id, and the technician still checks that the tape in the machine is that tape.

reach.task: Place the item the plan names, and hold any other.
reach.learn: The plan does not place the item.

evidence.claim: Showing a tape id already on the schedule is a lookup. It does not obtain, set up, or load the tape.
Setting aside the wrong tape is the technician's check after seeing it. The schedule cannot see the cassette.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An audio and video technician in a mid-size European company. A stored equipment id is not a repair, and a draft is not the show.
Fields: The schedule id and the tape id if one is already assigned. The id is not invented. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the audio technician finishes it by hand.
Native check: Read the schedule from the production board already in use before printing a new rundown.
unknowns: Whether tape is still physical in this company or has been replaced by files.
research_questions: Who assigns the tape id before the technician loads it?

already_counted.description: Obtaining, loading, and holding the wrong tape stay with the technician.

incremental.description: Clear tape ids left on closed broadcasts.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The technician still obtains, sets up, and loads the videotape, and still sets aside the wrong one. Only showing a tape id already on the schedule is removed. A broadcast with no tape id saves nothing.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the assignment text and the house sizes already stored.
Produce rough and finished graphics and graphic designs.
Reject a graphic that misses the assignment.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the assignment text and the house sizes already stored. The audio technician produces the rough graphic and the finished graphic design. A graphic that misses the assignment is rejected by the technician. The sizes do not draw the graphic. An assignment with no text leaves the screen blank. Nothing is published from this task.
tasks.previous_blocker: House sizes were a template file, and the assignment was a separate mail.
tasks.enabler_now: The assignment and the sizes can be shown together. Drawing the graphic stays with the technician.
tasks.still_hard: Whether the finished graphic meets the assignment is a judgement the sizes cannot make.
tasks.human_edge: The technician produces the graphic and rejects one that misses the assignment.
tasks.altitude: Graphics stay with the technician. House sizes and the assignment text are shown, and they are not the design.

reach.task: Accept or reject a graphic against the brief.
reach.learn: A size template is not the design.

evidence.claim: House sizes already stored set a frame. They do not produce a rough or a finished graphic.
Rejecting a graphic that misses the assignment is the technician's judgement. The assignment text does not make it.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An audio and video technician in a mid-size European company. A stored equipment id is not a repair, and a draft is not the show.

Fields: The assignment id, the assignment text, and the house sizes if they are already stored. The graphic is not generated. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the audio technician finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the sizes from the template already in the document store before making a new frame.
unknowns: Whether a designer, rather than the technician, produces the finished graphic.
research_questions: Who may reject a graphic, the technician or the art director?

already_counted.description: Producing the graphic and rejecting a miss stay with the technician.

incremental.description: Retire house sizes that the company no longer uses.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The technician still produces the rough and finished graphic and still rejects one that misses the assignment. Only showing the assignment text and house sizes already stored is removed. No graphic is generated.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Secure the location and the properties.

steps.what: Show the location list already approved for this production.
Locate and secure settings, properties, effects, and other production necessities.
Reject a place that cannot supply those production necessities.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the location list if one is already approved for the production. The audio technician locates and secures the setting, the properties, the effects, and the other necessities. A place that cannot supply them is rejected. The list does not secure the place. A production with no approved list leaves the screen blank.
tasks.previous_blocker: Locations were a shared mail thread, and a place was found unavailable on the day.
tasks.enabler_now: An approved location list can be shown. Securing the place still takes the technician's call or visit.
tasks.still_hard: A listed place can refuse the date, or lack the power the effects need.
tasks.human_edge: The technician secures the place and rejects one that cannot supply what the production needs.
tasks.altitude: Securing locations stays with the technician. The approved list is a starting set of names, not a booking.

reach.task: Confirm a location will actually host the shoot.
reach.learn: A name on a list is not a secured place.

evidence.claim: An approved location list names places already chosen. It does not locate or secure them.
Rejecting a place that cannot supply the necessities is the technician's judgement after asking. The list cannot know the refusal.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An audio and video technician in a mid-size European company. A stored equipment id is not a repair, and a draft is not the show.

Fields: The production id and the location list only if it is already approved. Places are not added by this step. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the audio technician finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the list from the document store before writing a new one.
unknowns: Whether locations are secured by this technician or by a producer.
research_questions: What counts as secured: a verbal yes, or a written permission?

already_counted.description: Securing the place and rejecting an unfit one stay with the technician.

incremental.description: Drop locations for productions that have closed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The technician still locates and secures the setting and the properties, and still rejects a place that cannot supply them. Only showing a location list already approved is removed. A production with no list saves nothing.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The technician still edits the programme, still loads the tape, still draws the graphic, and still secures the location. A rough assembly may be drafted from lines that already match, and it is not the edit.
reach: Photographers select frames, and this job learns a matched line is not the finished edit.
Art directors commission a graphic, and this job learns house sizes are not the design.
skills_to_grow: Edit the programme after any rough assembly, and keep only cuts that cite a real line.
Load the tape that the schedule names, and set aside any other.
Draw the graphic, and reject one that misses the assignment.
role.ambitious_version: A rough assembly cites the lines it came from, and the technician still makes the edit that is kept. Graphics and locations stay in the technician's hands.
